summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation and inventory reservation feature.

requirements.description: Reserve all order lines atomically, aggregating repeated SKUs prior to stock verification and ensuring all-or-nothing allocation without partial deductions.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: Current warehouse stock mapping and a requested set of order lines with potentially repeated SKUs
acceptance.when: Reservation is evaluated for the order lines
acceptance.then: All lines are reserved atomically if stock satisfies the aggregated quantities, or the reservation fails with insufficient_stock and stock remains untouched

requirements.description: Allocate inventory to expedited orders prior to normal orders while maintaining input arrival ordering within each priority level.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: A batch of orders containing both expedited and normal priority orders
acceptance.when: Orders are fulfilled against warehouse stock
acceptance.then: All valid expedited orders are processed in arrival order before normal orders are processed

requirements.description: Treat order IDs as idempotent by processing only the first occurrence of an ID and ignoring any subsequent duplicate orders with that ID.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: A sequence of orders containing duplicate occurrences of an order ID
acceptance.then: Only the first occurrence claims the ID and is evaluated; later occurrences with the same ID are completely ignored

requirements.description: Reject invalid orders or order lines without modifying warehouse stock or mutating caller input data structures.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: An order with invalid lines or invalid structure and caller input objects
acceptance.then: The order is rejected with an appropriate error reason, remaining stock reflects unchanged availability, and caller inputs are not mutated

assumptions: Stock is a plain object of nonempty SKU string keys mapping to nonnegative safe integers.
Order line quantities must be positive safe integers.
Orders with missing or invalid IDs are rejected as invalid_order with id set to null.
Identifiable orders with invalid priorities are rejected as invalid_order and still claim their ID against duplicates.
Input objects are never mutated by inventory or order fulfillment operations.
